column1: # Covers: brands, companies, products and product lines originating in or headquartered in France:
#   luxury and fashion houses, cosmetics and perfume, cars and models, food and drink (wine, champagne,
#   cognac, cheese), retail, banks and insurers, aerospace and industry, media, tech and games, hotels,
#   airlines, sports brands and football clubs.
# Hangul: Korean official/market names first (루이비통, 샤넬, 에르메스, 디올, 까르띠에, 르노, 푸조, 로레알,
#   랑콤, 꼬달리, 록시땅, 까르푸, 에비앙), then established Korean media spellings, else 프랑스어 외래어 표기법.
# Sources: Wikipedia "List of companies of France", "Category:French brands", CAC 40 / SBF 120 constituents,
#   Comité Colbert members, Brand Finance France 100, LVMH/Kering/L'Oréal/Pernod Ricard brand portfolios,
#   Korean brand sites and Korean news usage for Hangul forms.

# Note: compiled largely from the model's own knowledge; the lists named above describe the kinds of sources the entries follow and were not all consulted line by line. Hangul not checked line by line against Korean media.
